scope: exposed development feasibility for literal source-reporting eligibility/composition/missingness/resources, not biomedical interpretation or a locked test
case_selector: first two contexts explicitly listed in original user fixed ten-case pack; no response/performance/measurement-based selection
identifier_policy: Resolve only pinned approved HGNC symbol/Ensembl and selected Open Targets target records; missing/conflicting canonical ID blocks affected case, no replacement. Record mapping originals/versions as source ancestors.

source_policy.scope: already receipt-pinned selected inventory, not whole release
source_policy.record_selector: per exact targetId/diseaseId choose first two distinct native record IDs in lexical order; tie locator source_id,row_group,row; conflicting duplicate IDs block affected case without favorable substitution
source_policy.grouping: per-record identity and reported-date groups; cell context separate, unknown-only groups excluded
source_policy.field_projection: identity selectors plus requested columns; no clinical/status/outcome fields; Arrow filter before Python conversion

future_model_path: separately named typed-report-postvalidation-v1; ordinary local completion, no v2/v3 grammar inheritance
packet_isolation: Generation packet builder reads only eligible originals, neutral task and source provenance. It seals agent-visible packets before evaluator references are separately compiled; references and expected values never flow back.
missing_asset_policy: Report specific missing/denied file or permission, do not acquire or substitute. Optional23filebatch remains pending; no worker/monitor changes.
